notes:
What's new in DuckOS 1.0.92

• WhatsApp voice messages and other apps hear you again. While "Hey Duck" listened, this phone's audio put every app that recorded at the same time on its low-power wake-word microphone, which is nearly silent. Hey Duck and DuckAI now listen through the normal microphone.
• DuckAI no longer misses your first word.
• Settings > Sound shows your ringtone, notification and alarm sounds by name again, and they stay right after updates.
• Settings > Sound > Microphone > Test the microphone listens a little longer and also checks voice search.
